req.title: DELETE rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on DELETE for a non-existent playerId.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states DELETE /players/{playerId} must return HTTP 404 for a non-existent playerId. The SUT uses squad_number as the natural key for DELETE at /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Tests cover: (1) positive case — DELETE an existing player returns 204; (2) negative case — DELETE a non-existent squad_number returns exactly 404; (3) boundary case — squad_number just above the highest seeded value (26) returns 404; (4) boundary case — squad_number 0 (below minimum seeded value) returns 404; (5) state-transition case — DELETE existing then DELETE same again returns 404 on second call, confirming idempotent 404 after removal. Test[4] violation fixed: kind changed from 'negative' to 'boundary' since STC heuristic with a state-transition sequence covering boundary state (resource existence boundary before/after deletion) is correctly classified as boundary rather than negative.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — positive path: existing player deleted successfully
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_returns_404
preconditions: Database does NOT contain a player with squadNumber=9999
expected: Response status code is exactly 404, not 200, 204, or 400
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — error pathway: non-existent playerId must yield 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/9999')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.status_code != 200
assert response.status_code != 204
assert response.status_code != 400

tests.name: test_delete_squad_number_above_max_seeded_returns_404

squadNumber 27 does not exist in the database
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/27 (one above max seeded value)
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found — boundary just above highest seeded squad number
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — BVA boundary+1 above max seeded value (26+1=27) must yield 404
tests.executable:

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/27')
assert response.status_code == 404

expected: HTTP 404 Not Found — boundary just below lowest seeded squad number
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — BVA boundary-1 below min seeded value (1-1=0) must yield 404
tests.executable:

tests.name: test_delete_then_delete_same_player_returns_404
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/5 (second call — player no longer exists)
expected: Second DELETE returns HTTP 404 (state: player removed)
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — STC: after successful delete, resource transitions to non-existent state; subsequent DELETE must return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
first = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert first.status_code == 204
second = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert second.status_code == 404
assert second.status_code != 204
assert second.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_negative_squad_number_returns_404
preconditions: No player with a negative squadNumber exists in the database
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found — negative squad number is not a valid existing player
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — NEG: negative squad number cannot match any seeded player; must return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/-1')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.status_code != 422
assert response.status_code != 200

trace: R-PLAYER-015 — BVA: minimum seeded squad number (1) exists; DELETE must return 204, not 404
